remarks: Dreaming of coastal Orange County living without the coastal price tag? Discover the possibilities at 23627 Walters Court, tucked away in the desirable Hampton Village community of Laguna Niguel! This charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home enjoys a peaceful canyon-side setting, with no neighbors below and the convenience of a direct-access garage. Interior painting and installation of all-new outlets and switches are underway, creating a fresh, inviting space to call home. The kitchen and bathrooms retain their original cabinetry and countertops, while the existing flooring offers buyers the flexibility to enjoy the home as it is or personalize the finishes over time to reflect their own style.
